meta.method: WebSearch tool (standard mode), one search per query, US English. Results recorded in the order returned.
meta.caveat: PROXY, NOT A GOOGLE US SERP REPLICA. The WebSearch backend returns ~9-10 links, often including multiple locale/duplicate variants of one page (e.g. oracle.com/br, /nl, /ae), staging hosts and scraper/spam pages that Google would normally filter or cluster. Positions are therefore indicative only. Locale duplicates of the same page are collapsed into one row (noted in 'note'); 'pos' = first position returned. No paid SEO tool (Ahrefs/Semrush) data was available; no search volumes are implied.
